author: KEXP
description: Under the musical project Weird Nightmare, Alex Edkins returns with his latest release 'Hoopla.' Blending influences from ‘60s garage rock to ‘90s alternative, he hits the KEXP Studios with a live performance of "Headful Of Rain" and more.
title: Weird Nightmare performs "Headful Of Rain" & more Live on KEXP
